description: This file defines a PHP interface named 'Report' within the 'OrangeHRM Core Report' namespace. The interface declares methods for obtaining report header definitions, filter definitions, and report data based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header definition for the report, providing structured information about table headers.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter definition used to specify filtering options for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data based on provided filter parameters.
